question: Who invented the X-ray?
solution:
The correct answer is __**W K Roentgen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• X-rays were **discovered in 1895 by German physicist Wilhelm Roentgen**.
 
• He was the **first to examine them in-depth**, however, he is not thought to have been the first to see and feel their effects.
 
• **Roentgen** was a recipient of the **first Nobel Prize for Physics, in 1901, for his discovery of X-rays**, which heralded the age of modern physics and revolutionized diagnostic medicine.
 
• The most familiar **use of x-rays is checking for fractures** (broken bones).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a48480c81262e642163fd0ceb09ab04525ba7bf5fe282939fb4796b2d5e051d9.png]
